messages:
Jordan (Halcyon): Hey team — onboarding demo is tomorrow 09:00 PST. We expect a spike from our partner integration. Can you provision a temporary throughput bump + CIDR allowlist for our partner IPs in ap-southeast-3?

Alice CS: Thanks Jordan. Can you share target sustained QPS and burst, CIDRs, and how long you need the window? Also: do you need edge peering or just egress allowlist?

Jordan (Halcyon): Target sustained ~1200 qps, bursts to ~3000 for short periods. CIDRs: `203.0.113.0/27`, `198.51.100.128/28`. Need this for 7 days (tomorrow -> auto-revoke). Prefer peered edge if possible (lower latency).

Ben EngOps: Noted. @Maria NetOps if we do peering, lead time is ~48-72h. For a fast temporary window we can do CIDR allowlist + temporary rate increase on the regional route. Will need customer-side TLS SNI + cert details if peering.

Maria NetOps: Correct. For peering I need their ASN and BGP contacts. For simple allowlist we just need the CIDRs and the account id to bind. Peering: I'll open a ticket with infra-nets. ETA 2–3 days.

Sasha AE: Heads up — renewal is in 10 days. If we can show the demo runs smoothly with the peering/perf, it removes a renewal risk. Maybe propose a 30-day free Dedicated trial as a safety net?

Alice CS: Good call Sasha. Jordan, would you accept a 30-day trial of a small Dedicated pool if we can enable it quickly? It would give consistent perf for the renewal demo.

Jordan (Halcyon): Yes please — trial would be great. If that helps, go ahead. Priority is demo success.

Ben EngOps: Creating backend change now. Config snippet I will apply to the ap-southeast-3 route:```json
{
  "account": "halcyon",
  "region": "ap-southeast-3",
  "allowlist_cidrs": ["203.0.113.0/27", "198.51.100.128/28"],
  "rate_limit": {"sustained_qps": 1200, "burst_qps": 3000, "window_seconds": 60},
  "auto_revoke": "+7d",
  "peering_requested": true
}
```

Ben EngOps: Also need confirmation on auth mode — are they using API keys or mTLS? If mTLS, include cert CN. If API-key we'll whitelist their header `X-Partner-Key`.

Jordan (Halcyon): API keys for now. Header will be `X-Partner-Key`. No mTLS for this demo.

Alice CS: I've recorded the request and set reminder to review auto-revoke in 6 days. Also logging note: enable token-level trace for the demo window so we can capture latency and failure patterns for the renewal deck.

Maria NetOps: Opening peering ticket: INFRA-NET-3127. Asking for ASN, peering IPs, contact email. If they can share a /29 per side we can expedite.

Ben EngOps: Pushing rate/allowlist change to staging, then applying to prod after quick smoke. I'll post config change id.

deploy-bot: rate-limit-config-change queued (change_id: rl-2026-0458) — awaiting approval.

Alice CS: Approving rl-2026-0458 for immediate apply. Sasha, we also requested the 30-day Dedicated trial — billing/sales ok?

Sasha AE: I'll sign off and create the trial contract addendum. Informal approval granted; will attach to the renewal ops doc.

deploy-bot: rl-2026-0458 applied to ap-southeast-3; allowlist entries added: 203.0.113.0/27,198.51.100.128/28; sustained_qps=1200; burst_qps=3000; auto_revoke=+7d.

Maria NetOps: Peering ticket INFRA-NET-3127 created and routed to partner_peering@redwood.ai. ETA 36–48h if partner responds fast.

Jordan (Halcyon): Thanks all — seeing much better tail latency in our internal checks. Demo stand-by ready.

Alice CS: Can you capture any error samples during the demo and drop them here? We'll feed into Redwood Optimize to check config recs.

Jordan (Halcyon): Will do. One ask: after the demo, can you produce a short perf summary (p50/p95/p99, cost delta) we can share with our execs?

Ben EngOps: Yes — I'll export the route-level metrics and token-cost delta and post by EOD next day.

(48h later)

deploy-bot: INFRA-NET-3127: peering established between Redwood (AS65030) and Halcyon (AS64520). BGP session up.

Maria NetOps: Peering live for ap-southeast-3. Routing prefixes accepted. Jordan, expect ~30–50ms p95 improvement after routes propagate.

Jordan (Halcyon): Seeing ~40ms p95 improvement — demo went great. Thanks everyone.

Alice CS: Marking this case as "onboarded — peering + temp throughput". I'll follow up for formal feedback and send the perf summary to your execs. :tada:

Ben EngOps: Posted perf summary and cost delta: https://redwood.internal/reports/rl-2026-0458/summary (internal link)

Sasha AE: I'll attach the perf report to the renewal packet. Jordan — any qualitative notes from the demo attendees?

Jordan (Halcyon): Execs liked the responsiveness. One note: would prefer per-route caching suggestions — saw repeated prefixes that could be cached. Happy to jump on follow-up call to go deeper.

Alice CS: Great feedback — we'll schedule a short enablement session next week to walk caching/quantization tips. Closing loop after trial ends.

deploy-bot: rl-2026-0458 scheduled auto-revoke in 7 days (1769494799). Reminder set 24h before revoke.
